This error occurred because a message was sent to an email address hosted by Office 365, but the address doesn't exist in the receiving organization's Office 365 directory. Directory Based Edge Blocking (DBEB) is enabled for digitalbridge.com, and DBEB rejects messages addressed to recipients who don't exist in the receiving organization's Office 365 directory. This error is reported by the recipient domain's email server, but most often it can be fixed by the person who sent the message. If the steps in the How to Fix It section above don't fix the problem, and you're the email admin for the recipient, try one or more of the following:

Check that the email address exists and is correct - Confirm that the recipient address exists in your Office 365 directory, is correct, and is accepting messages.

Synchronize your directories - Make sure directory synchronization is working correctly, and that the recipient's email address exists in both Office 365 and in your on-premises directory.

Check for errant forwarding rules - Check for forwarding rules for the original recipient that might be trying to forward the message to an invalid address. Forwarding can be set up by an admin via mail flow rules or mailbox forwarding address settings, or by the recipient via the Forwarding or Inbox Rules features.

Make sure the recipient has a valid license - Make sure the recipient has an Office 365 license assigned to them. The recipient's email admin can use the Office 365 admin center to assign a license to them (Users > Active Users > Select the recipient > Assigned License > Edit).

Make sure that mail flow settings and MX records are correct - Misconfigured mail flow or MX record settings can cause this error. Check your Office 365 mail flow settings to make sure your domain and any mail flow connectors are set up correctly. Also, work with your domain registrar to make sure the MX records for your domain are set up correctly.

4006945/4608051152.email_body:
Hello Kate,

I saw that your Exa Infrastructure London office might be close to one of our clinics. We've got 38 physio locations across London and I'm sure one of them will work for you. We treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Thanks
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

Check for errant forwarding rules - Check for forwarding rules for the original recipient that might be trying to forward the message to an invalid address. Make sure the recipient has a valid license - Make sure the recipient has an Office 365 license assigned to them. The recipient's email admin can use the Office 365 admin center to assign a license to them (Users > Active Users > Select the recipient > Assigned License > Edit).

Make sure that mail flow settings and MX records are correct - Misconfigured mail flow or MX record settings can cause this error. Check your Office 365 mail flow settings to make sure your domain and any mail flow connectors are set up correctly. 4006945/4608050715.email_body:
Hey Mo,

I want to give you a 55-minute HCPC-registered physio session completely on me. Proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

I'm reaching out because I saw that your Emarsys office might be close to one of our clinics. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 

Check out my company in the signature for more info. Just reply and I’ll send you the booking code. 

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

How to Fix It
The address might be misspelled or might not exist. Try one or more of the following:
  • Retype the recipient's address, then resend the message - If you're using Outlook, open this non-delivery report message and click Send Again from the menu or ribbon. In Outlook on the web, select this message, and then click the "To send this message again, click here." link located just above the message preview window. In the To or Cc line, delete and then retype the entire recipient's address (ignore any address suggestions). After typing the complete address, click Send to resend the message. If you're using an email program other than Outlook or Outlook on the web, follow its standard way for resending a message. Just be sure to delete and retype the recipient's entire address before resending it.
  • Remove the recipient from the recipient Auto-Complete List, then resend the message - If you're using Outlook or Outlook on the web, follow the steps in the "Remove the recipient from the recipient Auto-Complete List" section of this article. Then resend the message. Be sure to delete and retype the recipient's entire address before clicking Send.
  • Contact the recipient by some other means, (by phone, for example) to confirm you're using the right address. Ask them if they've set up an email forwarding rule that could be forwarding your message to an incorrect address.
If the problem continues, ask the recipient to tell their email admin about the problem, and give them the error (and the name of the server that reported it) shown below. It's likely that only the recipient's email admin can fix this problem.

Was this helpful? Send feedback to Microsoft.

More Info for Email Admins
Status code: 550 5.4.1

This error occurred because a message was sent to an email address hosted by Office 365, but the address doesn't exist in the receiving organization's Office 365 directory. Directory Based Edge Blocking (DBEB) is enabled for emarsys.com, and DBEB rejects messages addressed to recipients who don't exist in the receiving organization's Office 365 directory. This error is reported by the recipient domain's email server, but most often it can be fixed by the person who sent the message. If the steps in the How to Fix It section above don't fix the problem, and you're the email admin for the recipient, try one or more of the following:

Check that the email address exists and is correct - Confirm that the recipient address exists in your Office 365 directory, is correct, and is accepting messages.

Synchronize your directories - Make sure directory synchronization is working correctly, and that the recipient's email address exists in both Office 365 and in your on-premises directory.

Check for errant forwarding rules - Check for forwarding rules for the original recipient that might be trying to forward the message to an invalid address. Forwarding can be set up by an admin via mail flow rules or mailbox forwarding address settings, or by the recipient via the Forwarding or Inbox Rules features.

Make sure the recipient has a valid license - Make sure the recipient has an Office 365 license assigned to them. The recipient's email admin can use the Office 365 admin center to assign a license to them (Users > Active Users > Select the recipient > Assigned License > Edit).

Make sure that mail flow settings and MX records are correct - Misconfigured mail flow or MX record settings can cause this error. Check your Office 365 mail flow settings to make sure your domain and any mail flow connectors are set up correctly. Also, work with your domain registrar to make sure the MX records for your domain are set up correctly.

For more information and additional tips to fix this issue, see this article.

Hey Rebecca,

I saw that your Sermo London office might be close to one of our clinics. We've got 38 physio locations across London and I'm sure one of them will work for you. We treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520621919.email_body:
Hello Lorna,

I noticed your London office is about 10 min walk from our Mayfair clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Thanks
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

I noticed your London office is about 10 min walk from our Mayfair clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Thanks
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

Hey Pambinos,

I noticed your London office is about 10 min walk from our Mayfair clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hi Louisa,

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Mayfair clinic is 10 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 

I want to give you a 55-minute session completely on me. HCPC-registered physio, proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I’ll send you the booking code.

Best regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hello Alexander,

I noticed your London office is about 10 min walk from our Fitzrovia clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Thanks
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520621554.email_body:
Hi Alex,

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Charing Cross clinic is 10 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 

I want to give you a 55-minute session completely on me. HCPC-registered physio, proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I'll send you the info on how to book.

Best regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hey George,

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Fitzrovia clinic is 10 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 

I want to give you a 55-minute session completely on me. HCPC-registered physio, proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I’ll send you the booking code.

Kind regards
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520620096.email_body:
Hey Sejal,

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Mayfair clinic is 9 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 

I want to give you a 55-minute session completely on me. HCPC-registered physio, proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I'll send you the info on how to book.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520620127.email_body:
Hello Henry,

I noticed your London office is about 9 min walk from our Mayfair clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Thanks
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

Check for errant forwarding rules - Check for forwarding rules for the original recipient that might be trying to forward the message to an invalid address. Make sure the recipient has a valid license - Make sure the recipient has an Office 365 license assigned to them. The recipient's email admin can use the Office 365 admin center to assign a license to them (Users > Active Users > Select the recipient > Assigned License > Edit).

Make sure that mail flow settings and MX records are correct - Misconfigured mail flow or MX record settings can cause this error. Check your Office 365 mail flow settings to make sure your domain and any mail flow connectors are set up correctly. Also, work with your domain registrar to make sure the MX records for your domain are set up correctly.

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520618551.email_body:
Hey Harriet,

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Mayfair clinic is 8 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 

I want to give you a 55-minute session completely on me. HCPC-registered physio, proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I'll send you the info on how to book.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick

Hi Joel,

Good news , we've got a clinic closer to Bloomsbury now. Holborn is right there (c/o Spaces Theobalds Road, 98 Theobalds Rd), and King's Cross is another option if that works better for you.

The 55-minute session is a proper assessment plus hands-on manual treatment from an HCPC-registered physio. Nothing generic, we work out what's actually going on, treat it, and give you a clear picture of what you need going forward. No pressure to book again after that. One session, and that's it, if that's what you want.

Great that you've got a Cash Plan. We run those end-to-end, so once you've booked the first session and we know your insurer, we can get you set up to claim any future sessions without doing the paperwork yourself.

Here's your booking link: https://onebodyldn.connect.tm3app.com/book/services/physiotherapy/physiotherapy_55min_1

The code is OBLACCESS55. There's a small £4.99 booking fee, which holds your time slot. Pick whichever clinic works, let me know if you need anything else.

Rebecca

Hey Geoff,

I noticed your London office is about 7 min walk from our Shoreditch clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Kind regards
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520616767.email_body:
Hi Jonathan,

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Liverpool Street clinic is 7 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 

I want to give you a 55-minute session completely on me. HCPC-registered physio, proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I'll send you the info on how to book.

Best regards
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520615614.email_body:
Hey Gary,

I noticed your London office is about 7 min walk from our Bank clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520615503.email_body:
Hello Syed,
I want to give you a 55-minute HCPC-registered physio session completely on me. Proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Bank clinic is 7 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 
Reply and I’ll send you the booking code.

Thanks
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520615527.email_body:
Hello Marcus,

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Bank clinic is 7 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 

I want to give you a 55-minute session completely on me. HCPC-registered physio, proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I’ll send you the booking code.

Thanks
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520615543.email_body:
Hey Jane,

I noticed your London office is about 7 min walk from our Bank clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Kind regards
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520615227.email_body:
Hi Matthew,
I want to give you a 55-minute HCPC-registered physio session completely on me. Proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Mayfair clinic is 7 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 
Reply and I’ll send you the booking code.

Best regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hello Jayesh,

I noticed your London office is about 7 min walk from our Fitzrovia clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Thanks
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520615101.email_body:
Hi Alan,

I noticed your London office is about 7 min walk from our Vauxhall clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Best regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

I noticed your London office is about 6 min walk from our Moorgate clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Thanks
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hello Kar,

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Moorgate clinic is 6 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 

I want to give you a 55-minute session completely on me. HCPC-registered physio, proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I’ll send you the booking code.

Thanks
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hey Sachin,

I noticed your London office is about 6 min walk from our Victoria clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520613471.email_body:
Hey Bill,

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Victoria clinic is 6 min walk from your office. We’ve got 38 locations across London, and we treat a lot of people doing more or less your job, from KPMG, PwC and Deloitte among others. We fix backs, necks, shoulders, knees. Mostly from sitting. 

I want to give you a 55-minute session completely on me. HCPC-registered physio, proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I'll send you the info on how to book.

Kind regards
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

3930675/4520610876.email_body:
Hello Diana,

I noticed your London office is about 5 min walk from our Fulham clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Thanks
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

Hello Clarence,

I noticed your Hubxchange London office is about 3 min walk from our Holborn clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Hubxchange gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Thanks
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

3876232/4446317836.email_body:
Hi Sam,

I noticed your Apposite London office is about 2 min walk from our Blackfriars clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Apposite gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Best regards
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

I run One Body LDN and I’m reaching out because I saw that our Fenchurch Street clinic is 3 min walk from your office. I want to give you a 55-minute session completely on me. HCPC-registered physio, proper hands-on treatment, and you'll know what's actually going on by the end of it.

Reply and I'll send you the info on how to book.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hello Zoe,

I noticed your Thinkbox London office is about 4 min walk from our Holborn clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Thinkbox gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Thanks
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hello Laura,

I noticed your PLP London office is about 3 min walk from our Mayfair clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if PLP gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Thanks
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

3876232/4446316649.email_body:
Hi Karen,

I noticed your Octopus London office is about 1 min walk from our Blackfriars clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Octopus gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Best regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hey Navi,

I noticed your Templeton & Partners London office is about 3 min walk from our Liverpool Street clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Templeton & Partners gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Kind regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hey Paul,

I noticed your Lickd London office is about 3 min walk from our Shoreditch clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Lickd gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Kind regards
Kurt Johnson
Co-Founder @ One Body LDN

Hi David,

I noticed your Apposite London office is about 2 min walk from our Blackfriars clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Apposite gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Best regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hi Lola,

I noticed your Neverland London office is about 3 min walk from our Shoreditch clinic.

Hi Linda,

I noticed your Albion Capital London office is about 3 min walk from our Farringdon clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Albion Capital gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Best regards
Kurt Johnson

Hi Kiri,

I noticed your London office is about 4 min walk from our Holborn clinic. We've got 38 physio locations across London and we treat people from KPMG, Deloitte, and PwC. We fix backs, necks and shoulders. Mostly the kind people pick up from sitting at a desk eight hours a day. 

So here's what I'd like to do give you: a 55-minute session with an HCPC-registered physio, completely on me. Proper assessment plus hands-on treatment, not an exercise sheet. 

Want me to send the booking link over? It is completely on me.

Best regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hi Deborah,

I noticed your Resources London office is about 2 min walk from our City of London clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if Resources gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Best regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN

Hi Chandra,

I noticed your PNB International London office is about 2 min walk from our Clerkenwell clinic.

Reason I'm writing: if PNB International gives you private health cover, physio is almost certainly included in it. Most people barely touch it. I run One Body LDN. 38 physio locations across London, 7,764 reviews at 4.9, and we see a lot of people from big companies like KPMG, Deloitte and PwC.

So if something's nagging like lower back from sitting, neck, shoulder, a knee that complains when you run, we'll do your provider side from start to finish. Booking and paperwork. Most people are surprised to find nothing comes out of pocket.

And if you haven't got cover, your first 55-minute session with hands-on treatment is on us anyway. Want me to send you the booking code? Just reply and it's yours.

Best regards
Rebecca Bossick
Clinical Director @ One Body LDN
